name: Automate Content Generator for WordPress with DeepSeek R1
description: This workflow automates content generation for WordPress using the DeepSeek R1 AI model, enabling rapid content creation.

inputs.prompt:
You are an SEO Copywriter and you need to think of a title of maximum 60 characters for the following article:
{{last.text}}

Instructions:
- Use keywords contained in the article
- Do not use any HTML characters
- Output only the string containing the title.
- Do not use quotation marks. The only special characters allowed are ":" and ","

setup: "Upload image": yantra-storage/YANTRA_STORAGE_HTTP_SEND comes from the yantra-storage HTTP send and signatures patch (1.4.1), which is not published yet; this step fails until it ships, then the template promotes on the next catalog refresh.
Setup value spreadsheetId: Spreadsheet id (for example 1AbC...xyz). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.

Workflow secret YOURSITE_BASIC_AUTH: yoursite.com WordPress application password as Basic auth (base64 of "user:app-password") for yoursite.com (Authorization: Basic <secret>). Add it in the workflow editor's Secrets panel after import; never paste it in chat.

Workflow secret WP_BASIC_AUTH: wp.test.7hype.com WordPress application password as Basic auth (base64 of "user:app-password") for wp.test.7hype.com (Authorization: Basic <secret>). Add it in the workflow editor's Secrets panel after import; never paste it in chat.

hints: "Upload image" authenticated with wordpressApi in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).
"Upload image" sends its binaryData body with yantra-storage HTTP_SEND (public https hosts only, 25 MB, 120 s); the file comes from "Generate Image with DALL-E".
"Set Image" authenticated with wordpressApi in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
Connect wordpress: `cdecli credential create -n "wordpress" -p wordpress --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
## Target
This workflow is designed to automatically generate seo-friendly content for wordpress through DeepSeek R1 by giving input ideas on how to structure the article. A cover image is also generated and uploaded with OpenAI DALL-E 3. This flow is designed to be executed automatically (ad "On a schedule" node) and thus have a complete editorial plan.

This process is useful for blog managers who want to automate content creation and publishing.

## Preliminary step
Create a google sheet with the following columns:
- Date
- Prompt
- Title
- Post ID

Fill in only the "Prompt" column with basic ideas that DeepSeek will work on to generate the content.
Connect with your Google Sheet. This node select only rows for which no content has been generated yet in WordPress
Add your DeepSeek API credential. If you want you can change the model with "deepseek-chat"
Upload the image on your WordPress via APIs
Set the uploaded image with the newly created article
